name: Baby Safety Monitor
description: AI-based smart baby safety monitoring and emergency alert system for vehicles — detects whether a baby seat is occupied/safe and escalates to parents if something looks wrong and nobody responds.
highlights: Sensor fusion on Raspberry Pi 5: radar presence, camera + YOLO vision, cry detection via audio spectrogram transformer, cabin temperature/weight.
ESP32 sensor-hub firmware (microphone + mmWave radar) feeding the Pi over a documented hardware link.
Rule-based alert escalation — push notification first, then SMS — if a parent doesn't respond in time.
Companion Android app in Kotlin + Jetpack Compose: live dashboard, alert acknowledgment, editable family profile.
Local SQLite storage with Firestore sync for real-time cross-device state.

name: Guardian — Smart Medicine Box
description: A web-based smart medicine management system for elderly care, combining QR-based digital prescriptions, a Firebase real-time database, and an ESP32-powered IoT medicine box.
highlights: Prescription QR Code Generator: turns a digital prescription (medicine, time slot, quantity) into a structured JSON payload and downloadable QR code.
Fixed dosing schedule mapped to time slots — morning, noon, evening, night — read directly off the QR.
Guardian Smart Medicine Box Control site drives an ESP32-based dispenser that reads the schedule and unlocks the right drawer at the right time.
Firebase real-time database keeps the prescription generator and the box control dashboard in sync.

name: Hotel Reservation System
description: Desktop application for managing core hotel operations — guest reservations, room status, payments and administrative reporting — built with Java Swing and a Firebase Firestore backend.
highlights: Guest management with full CRUD, plus room management across Single/Double/Deluxe/Suite types with Available/Booked/Under-Maintenance status tracking.
Booking engine with date-range availability search and automated check-in/check-out that updates room status.
Payment tracking across Cash/Card/Online, with full guest bills generated at check-out.
Multi-level authentication with Admin, Manager and Receptionist roles, each scoped to specific permissions.
Daily revenue and monthly booking reports, plus a live view of current in-house guests.

name: Garments Factory ERP System
description: Desktop-based ERP system for garments factory operations covering inventory, production, employee management and order tracking.
highlights: Modules for inventory, production, employee management and order tracking.
Optimized SQL database schema for efficient storage and retrieval.
Interactive GUI built with JavaFX & Swing.
Automated reporting and workflow to reduce manual errors.

name: BAUST Library Management System
description: A console-based library management program written in pure C for the BAUST university library, covering books, members and issue/return transactions with binary-file persistence.
highlights: Admin login system gating access to the management console.
Book, student, teacher and computer inventory management with add/view/search.
Book issue/return transaction system with an overdue fine-calculation placeholder.
All records persisted to binary .dat files (books, students, teachers, computers, transactions) — no external database needed.
Built to demonstrate structures, file I/O and modular programming in C for a real university library.

name: Abbasuddin Ahmed Hall Management System
description: A C++ console-based OOP system for managing student residence hall operations at BAUST — students, staff, dining and visitors — with persistent file-backed storage.
highlights: Student management: roll/department/year/room assignment, fee status tracking, and stored complaints.
Staff management with attendance tracking and automatic monthly salary calculation.
Dining management that logs breakfast/lunch/dinner per student and auto-calculates the monthly meal bill.
Visitor log recording who visited whom and when, with full history lookup.
All data persisted to text-based .dat files for students, staff, dining and visitors.

name: BAUST Bulletin
description: A social-media style bulletin platform for the BAUST community, built on a Node.js/Express backend with a JavaScript front end.
highlights: Node.js + Express server backing a campus social feed / bulletin board.
JavaScript front end for posting and browsing community updates.

name: Personal Portfolio — v1

highlights: First live version of my personal site, deployed via GitHub Pages.
Superseded by the current Next.js + Tailwind rebuild, kept here as a milestone.

String concatenation (library and manual), string comparison and pattern matching.
